newsitem.title: USA: US sells 2.5 mln barrels SPR oil at average $22.66.
newsitem.headline: US sells 2.5 mln barrels SPR oil at average $22.66.

text.p: The U.S. Energy Department said Wednesday it sold 2.459 million barrels of oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve this week at an average $22.66 per barrel, completing this round of SPR sales.
Awards this week were made to Basis Petroleum, FINA Oil and Chemical, and Mobil Oil.
The department said it sold a total of 10.204 million barrels at an average prices of $21.62 per barrel to generate $220.635 million, to complete the sale ordered by Congress to raise $220 million.

Awarded to Basis Petroleum were 34,046 barrels at $23.80 per barrel for December-January barge delivery, 750,000 at $21.80 for December-January tanker delivery, and 225,000 barrels at $22.80 for January pipeline delivery.
Awarded to Fina Oil and Chemical were 350,000 barrels at $23.20 per barrel, 350,000 at $23.10, and 300,000 at $23.00, all for January pipeline delivery.
Awarded to Mobil Oil were 225,000 barrels at $22.95 per barrel and 225,000 at $22.90, both for January pipeline delivery.
Basis' purchase of 34,046 barrels was of Nigerian Qua Iboe sweet crude oil located at Sunoco terminal, while remaining purchases were of West Hackberry sour crude oil, the Energy Department said.
